<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant monoisotopic peak at ~100 Da with a ~5.6 % M+1 peak and rapidly decreasing higher peaks—the only element showing a clear, characteristic isotopic distribution is carbon (13C). No significant M+2 peaks indicative of Cl, Br, or S are present, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
